purpose: Prospective small test-subset evaluation, frozen before downloading selected imagery or examining labels/predictions; not a full benchmark or independent geospatial split.
selection: Enumerate matching A/B/label PNG parent filenames in pinned test archive, exclude every previously used parent scene, rank by sha256('geoalibi-eval-2026-10-31:' + filename), select first 8. Keep all 1024px images, no label-based selection or crop picking.
tuning: No threshold sweeps or adaptation to these results. Publish all selected scenes and failures.
metrics: Full processed footprint precision, recall, F1, IoU and verification transitions for each arm. Rejected pixels count negative; empty precision is null.
terms: LEVIR academic research only, no commercial use; underlying Google Earth terms apply. No imagery redistributed. Model weights CC-BY-4.0 with original attribution. Mirror membership does not establish geographic independence or audit the author's training split.
